message:
Fixed. In `src/payments/partial-refund.js`, `partialRefund` multiplied the amount by `percent` (0–100) without dividing by 100. A 50% refund therefore came out 50 times too large. It now computes `Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100)`.

`npm test` passes: all 20 tests, including `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js`.
